decisions.reason: Changing badge identities and icons does not alter random prize selection or ticket-weighted winning probabilities.
The First Referral badge and icon decisions do not change Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility, weighting, or reset behavior.
The badge catalog modification does not change Big Block ticket issuance, eligibility, weighting, or reset behavior.
Replacing a badge associated with minting does not change primary-mint revenue allocation.
Introducing a First Referral badge does not change the amount or automatic payout mode of the referral commission.
The badge catalog decision does not alter ticket allocation when no referral code is used.
NFT metadata is required to expose permanent badges, so replacing First Mint with First Referral necessarily changes the badge identity that accurate metadata must represent.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hmmm yeah, having the same icon appear twice feels a little strange—maybe it could be a big smily face or something?

I do quite like the sapling icon for 'growing network'.

Also, 'first mint' may be somewhat redundant because everyone will have it, so we could replace it with a 'first referral' badge.

value_updates.permanent_badge_catalog: Use the First Referral badge instead of the First Mint badge.

The badge catalog modification is unrelated to the Mauritius landing-page access restriction.
